Chapter 1308 - 48: Greetings, Young Friend

Chapter 1308: Chapter 48: Greetings, Young Friend

"Inconceivable."

"Unheard of."

"Unimaginable."

One Eternal Lord after another spoke, expressing their feelings.

As time lifeforms, they have seen countless future timelines, no matter how surreal.

But for someone like Lin Yuan, if they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, they wouldn’t believe it at all.

The Master of Infinite gazed distantly at the source world and said, "Gentlemen, I plan to return once, to meet that ’Galaxy’ friend."

Although in many future timelines, the Master of Infinite judged that Lin Yuan wasn’t difficult to get along with.

Yet in a more distant future, even we, the Eternal Lords, would still need to rely on him.

Therefore, meeting in advance to build a good relationship is extremely important.

In the future timeline where Lin Yuan exists, the so-called demon calamity could basically be overcome.

So what the Eternal Lords consider is how to coexist with Lin Yuan after the demon calamity ends.

"Return once?"

The Master of Black Space, Master of Wushan, and other Eternal Lords’ expressions slightly changed.

Returning to the source world requires crossing the barrier separating light and demonic paths.

When the world changed dramatically, the Eternal Lords exhausted many isolation techniques to restrain the Light Lord’s bright body, creating a stalemate here.

Doing so not only contained the Light Lord’s bright body but also locked themselves entirely to this place.

But nothing is absolute. At the level of the Eternal Lords, there are countless methods, and escaping this lock, to briefly return to the source world,

isn’t impossible.

It just requires a tremendous price.

Moreover, even if returning to the source world, it would only be a conscious avatar, unable to rival the Light Lord’s Black Demon body.

Therefore, it is basically meaningless.

Previously, the thirteen Eternal Lords never had this thought.

But now?

Even at a huge cost,

as long as one can return to the source world and establish contact with that ’Galaxy’ in advance, any cost is worth it.

As time lifeforms, what they see and plan is not limited to the present but the distant future.

Perhaps paying a huge price to return, in the short term seems disadvantageous.

But over an extended timeline, as long as they can befriend Lin Yuan, make good with the future Time Lord,

what is this cost?

Furthermore, Lin Yuan is absolutely not an ordinary Time Lord.

With such an almost certain future life, the origin is so significant, the thirteen Eternal Lords dare not think deeply.

"I will also return."

"Since Infinite is going back, then I will return too."

...

Upon hearing this, the other twelve Eternal Lords immediately made up their minds.

If the Master of Infinite had not brought this up, some Eternal Lords might have hesitated due to the large cost.

But since the Master of Infinite plans to return, other Eternal Lords could naturally only follow.

Otherwise, if twelve Eternal Lords returned to get acquainted with ’Galaxy’ and only one did not go,

many opportunities in future timelines would likely have nothing to do with them.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan’s true body sat cross-legged, surrounded by drifting Chaos Qi.

Accompanied by the continuous opening of infinite Constant Sand Particle Worlds within his body, Lin Yuan’s aura grew increasingly profound, like an unprecedented massive black hole, instinctively devouring all void chaos in all directions.

"Runes?"

Lin Yuan hadn’t invested much thought in opening particle worlds.

In the second source world, he had already traversed it once, and now it was merely a repetition, naturally effortless and relaxed.

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s focus was on the application of runes.

"Time..."

With a slight thought, numerous tiny runes condensed in his mind, forming miniature timelines, stretching towards the future.

Reaching the level of "thought becomes rune," Lin Yuan’s mastery of runes seemed instinctual; likewise, watching timelines. Although far from as clear as true time lifeforms or the number of timelines seen,

this feeling of absolute control over timelines still captivated him.

"Future."

Lin Yuan looked at one of his future timelines.

In this timeline, Lin Yuan transformed into a true time lifeform in eight thousand years and then began exploring the dimensions beyond the Chaos Void.

Thereafter, as Lin Yuan continued his deep observation, he felt a certain resistance.

"The farther I observe the timeline, the more resistance I encounter. I am not yet a true time lifeform, and even if I forge another path, I can watch time life, but not for long."

Lin Yuan thought silently.

"However, once I step into the thirteenth stage, with my understanding of the Rune Dao and the transformation of my life’s essence, the timelines I see, in both number and depth, should far exceed other newly promoted time lifeforms."

Lin Yuan thought quietly to himself.

Without yet being a time lifeform, he could try watching timelines on his own.

If he becomes a time lifeform, the enhancement he receives would surely far exceed other newly promoted time lifeforms.

"But my future..."

Lin Yuan spent more than half a day observing dozens of his own timelines and discovered, just as the six ancestors had said, that in every timeline he stepped into the Thirteenth Layer and became a Time Life.

"What on earth is the reason for this?"

Lin Yuan was puzzled in his heart. As his realm and strength improved, he increasingly realized the difficulty of breaking through from the Twelfth Layer to the Thirteenth Layer.

Breaking through the time loop is not a certainty, at most, it just increases the possibility of breaking through, but for him, it is inevitable?

"Is it related to the Myriad Realms Gate?"

Lin Yuan speculated in his heart, "Or, even the time loop cannot block the Myriad Realms Gate?"

Lin Yuan expanded on his numerous associations.

Of course.

These were all just Lin Yuan’s speculations.

As for whether they are true or not, only falling into a time loop would reveal them.

"With my current foundation, even without relying on the Myriad Realms Gate, the possibility of breaking through the time loop is very, very high."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, cultivators practicing the Martial Arts Evolution Road are spread across dozens of dimensional spaces, and the sheer number they form the ’anchor’ is absolutely astounding.

Secondly, with the inheritance left by the Lord of Heaven Light, Lin Yuan’s use of runes has reached the level where he can think and it becomes reality, even if deeply trapped in a time loop, he could ’cheat’ to a certain extent.

Lastly, there is Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

For ten thousand years, Lin Yuan has comprehended the myriad great Dao rules, involving such a vast scope that it is estimated that even real time lives cannot compare with him.

Once deeply trapped in a time loop, even facing tests he has never encountered before, mastering them becomes easy as he gains more strategies to respond.

Lin Yuan really wants to know, just how long can a time loop trap him.

"Hmm?"

Everything Lin Yuan’s gaze fell upon was runes, and he quickly saw through most of the essence of the Chaos Void.

"Is that where the Thirteenth Layer Time Lives of the Chaos Void typically reside?" Relying on the power of runes, Lin Yuan discovered that there are seven places with long-lasting auras in the Chaos Void that he could not yet fully understand, deducing that they must be the time lives of the Chaos Void.

"Seven Time Lives?"

Lin Yuan pondered, this was the first time he knew the number of Time Lives in the Chaos Void.

The Chaos Void has dozens of special places, but that doesn’t mean there are dozens of time lives. Each time life observes potential risks of the Chaos Void and establishes multiple special places to compensate.

"Chaos Void is not a source world, yet the number of time lives it can produce is not small." Lin Yuan couldn’t help but sigh.

The first source world’s time lives only number six, who are the six ancestors.

Of course, this is because the first source world hasn’t existed long enough to nurture new time lives.

...

"I can attempt to reach the Thirteenth Layer at any time now."

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts, faintly feeling strands of time power swirling around him.

This is because Lin Yuan’s life essence is so powerful that the power of time clings to him actively. As soon as Lin Yuan decides to reach the Thirteenth Layer by enhancing his life essence, these time powers will immediately form a loop to trap him.

"I’ll wait until I’ve fully opened the particle world."

Lin Yuan gently shook his head.

In the dozen or so future timelines he had just seen, the soonest he attempted to reach the Thirteenth Layer was also several thousand years later.

Since his future self did it that way, there must be a reason for it, and he saw no need to deliberately go against it.

At least the results of those futures all had him successfully reaching the Thirteenth Layer. If he went against it, new timelines could be born, leading to variables in his reaching the Thirteenth Layer.

That would indeed give Lin Yuan a headache.

...

The second source world.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In the distance, faint demonic qi could be seen.

"Demon God..."

Lin Yuan pondered, "The so-called Demon God is the Black Demon body forged by the Lord of Heaven Light, so what about his Light Body?"

This thought had just arisen.

Lin Yuan already had the answer in his heart.

The Light Body of the Lord of Heaven Light has been held back by the Eternal Lords.

Since the great change began, the Eternal Lords all disappeared simultaneously, and the Light Body of the Lord of Heaven Light also vanished without a trace.

The demonic qi enveloping the entire source world all originates from the Black Demon Body of the Lord of Heaven Light, which is the Demon God, yet the Light Body never appeared.

The simultaneous disappearance of the Eternal Lords and the Light Body of the Lord of Heaven Light.

The reason is self-evident.

"According to the Lord of Heaven Light, his Light Body is slightly superior to the Black Demon Body in power."

Lin Yuan thought in his heart, "I suppose the thirteen Eternal Lords are now stalemated with the Light Body of the Lord of Heaven Light."

If the thirteen Eternal Lords had suppressed the Light Body, they should have long returned by now.

If they hadn’t suppressed it, but were instead suppressed by the Light Body of the Lord of Heaven Light, then the Light Body should also have returned.

"Lord of Heaven Light..." Lin Yuan once again felt the power of this Eternal Lord.

Under the premise of losing mental will, his two true bodies respectively held back the entire source world and the thirteen Eternal Lords.

At this moment——

Buzz buzz buzz~ The surrounding space-time surged, and an ocean-like consciousness descended near Lin Yuan.

Each ocean-like consciousness condensed into towering figures, forming thirteen figures standing quietly there.

The appearance of these thirteen figures caused the entire source world to tremble, infinite demonic qi began to churn, and the presence of the Demon God started to coagulate again.

"What is this?"

Lin Yuan was shocked, looking at the thirteen towering figures not far away.

The leading towering figure wore a smile, gazing benevolently at Lin Yuan, "Infinite greets the young friend."
